content.speaker: Narration
content.text: Aoi waits for you on the rooftop, gazing at the horizon. The wind ruffles her hair slightly.

content.speaker: Aoi
content.text: Hey… thanks for coming. I wanted to talk to you.

content.speaker: Player
content.text: Sure, Aoi. What's on your mind?

content.speaker: Aoi
content.text: I… I’m going to transfer schools next month.

content.speaker: Narration
content.text: Her voice trembles as she looks down, hugging her arms. You can see her eyes glisten with unshed tears.

content.speaker: Aoi
content.text: I just… wanted to say goodbye properly. But… I feel so sad.

choices.text: Play a trick: point to a bug nearby

content.speaker: Player
content.text: It’s okay, Aoi. I know it’s hard, but I hope this new place will be good for you.

content.speaker: Narration
content.text: She looks up at you, a small smile forming. Her shoulders relax slightly.

content.speaker: Aoi
content.text: Thank you… I really needed to hear that.

content.speaker: Narration
content.text: The sadness lingers, but your words seem to soothe her, making the farewell a bit lighter.

content.speaker: Narration
content.text: You point to a small bug crawling near her feet. Aoi jumps back with a squeal, tears forming instantly.

content.speaker: Narration
content.text: You carefully remove the bug. Aoi watches, her tension slowly easing. She wipes her tears and giggles nervously.

content.speaker: Aoi
content.text: Haha… you’re ridiculous! I was so scared, but… I feel better now.

content.speaker: Narration
content.text: Her smile returns, genuine and relaxed. The sadness from before fades slightly, replaced by warmth and laughter.
